Read the numbers with context

Revenue / spend compares recorded revenue with recorded channel spend. It is not profit or an attribution model. Cost per new customer uses the new-customer counts supplied in your CSV. Cross-channel customers may overlap.

STOCK SCENARIO

Projected units over the next 14 days

Aggregate scenario only. Check product-level stock and supplier lead times before ordering.

How the forecast works

At least 14 distinct dates of observations in the latest 28 days are required. The last seven days supply a repeating weekday pattern. Week-over-week unit growth is capped at ±25%, then applied proportionally across the next two weeks. Missing dates count as zero. Promotions, holidays, price changes, and stockouts are not modeled.

A simple data contract

One row per date, channel, and product. Repeated rows add together. Use nonnegative values and whole numbers for counts.

channel / product

orders / units

revenue / spend
Amounts in Indian rupees (INR)
new_customers
First-time orders, at most the order count
